money.evidence: at a cost not to exceed $250,000.00

output.headline: Cuts the Audit Committee from seven members to five starting February 1, 2024
output.summary: The board is amending Board Bylaw 9131, which covers advisory and oversight committees. The change reduces the number of Audit Committee members from seven to five, effective February 1, 2024. There is no cost.

output.headline: Approves Measure G1 grant changes for Frick United Academy and carryover funds for two schools
output.summary: The board is adopting a resolution that follows the Measure G1 oversight commission's recommendation. It approves an amended 2023-2024 Measure G1 grant proposal for Frick United Academy of Language. It also approves requests to carry over and spend 2022-2023 Measure G1 funds at Frick United Academy of Language and Oakland Charter Academy. The text does not state dollar amounts.

output.headline: Adopts a resolution naming members to some open seats on the Career Technical Education Advisory Committee

output.headline: Ratifies three appointments to the Measures N and H College and Career Readiness Commission
output.summary: The board is ratifying the board president's appointment of one new member and the reappointment of two others, one of whom serves as chair, to the commission that oversees Measures N and H. Terms start February 1, 2024 and end January 31, 2026.

output.headline: Reappoints two members to the district's Audit Committee through January 2026
output.summary: The board is ratifying the board president's reappointment of two Audit Committee members, one to a third term and one to a second term. Each has given satisfactory service so far. The new term runs from February 1, 2024 through January 31, 2026.
